plain: A researcher named Dave Rossi says on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2025 that Hal Puthoff, a physicist, invented a way to communicate using what are called vector and scalar potentials, deeper quantities in the physics of electricity and magnetism that sit beneath ordinary electric and magnetic fields. Michels tells it again in 2026, saying Puthoff is now working on a quantum communications company built on those same potentials. If true, it would mean a kind of signalling that works outside ordinary radio.
